dataList.content:
... Haah. Hah.
……呼。呼。
dataList.place:
Yong-jin Building 6F Office
龙进大楼 6层 办公室
dataList.title:
Blade Lineage?
剑契组？

dataList.content:
Bamboo-hatted Kim kneeled and caught his breath. Something began to shimmer behind him.
他跪倒地上喘着粗气，很快，某种晃动着的东西出现在了他背后。

This is a dungeon—A Mirror Dungeon of the Fathoms.
那是心象镜像迷宫。

This is just like the Dingdong's Bar & Fryers, huh?
和叮咚家炸鸡酒吧那时候一样的地方，对吧？

It's 'Eunbong's', Gregor. 'Eunbong's'...
是银凤、银凤……

He has already entered the dungeon.
他已经进去了。

Haah... so we've got to follow the bloke, eh?
哈啊……那啥，我们该追进去吧？

<Yeah... we were ordered to secure the Distortion as well. So...>
<嗯……因为确保扭曲也是我们的任务。>

... An immense, heavy sensation emanates from within that space.
然后……里面散发出一种之前从未体会过的，出人意料的沉重感。

<That 'Monolith' has to be somewhere in there, too.>
<恐怕……那个独石就在里面。>

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... Let us follow.
……我们跟上吧。

While she was clearly dumbfounded by the turn of events, I could tell that she was determined to see this to the end. We had nothing more to add.
面对这样难以接受的情况，她的神情十分茫然，但看着她那坚定了决心的样子，我们全都默不作声了。

Advancing.
进入。

This is...
这是……
dataList.place:
Mirror Dungeon of the Fathoms
心象镜像迷宫
dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组

dataList.content:
This place has taken the likeness of S Corp...
像是S公司的风景……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Not just anywhere in S Corp.
并非是单纯的S公司。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
You call this place the 'fathoms of ego'...? It appears that mentor Bamboo-hatted Kim's memories are... affecting this place.
心象……是这么说的吧。金笠大人的记忆……似乎在影响这个地方。

Is there aught from his past that you are aware of?
你知道些什么吗？

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
No... nothing in detail. I don't believe I have the right to divulge a depiction of his past based on hearsay, either.
不……我并不知晓详情。我也不觉得自己有资格只根据只言片语就能阐明他的过去。

Aeng-du continued in a morose tone.
樱桃用低沉的声调继续说道。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
When he appeared so suddenly at this building...
突然出现在这栋大楼里的时候。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... I don't suppose he had much trouble cutting down the Kurokumo Clan henchmen.
……头领他，大概很顺利地斩杀了黑云会的人吧。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I am certain he was flanked by competent men and women. It would not have mattered how many henchmen they threw against the mentor; nothing short of a Kurokumo Clan officer could have given him any trouble. In fact, I surmise that he would have been able to cut down a hundred of their men on his own.
陪在头领身边的人们都很优秀，即使面对黑云会这样的大规模帮派，只要不是干部，哪怕帮派成员众多，他也能以一敌百。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
But...
但是……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Not all those who accompanied master Bamboo-hatted Kim were as powerful as he. His capabilities lie far beyond our own.
若是问到周围的人们是否全都像金笠大人那样强大，那又是另当别论了。因为他和我们这些人，有着天壤之别啊。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
His fellows must have fallen one by one before the endless onslaught of the Kurokumo Clan henchmen.
在面对不断袭来的黑云会的家伙们时……他的友人们一定被一个个地杀死了吧。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
And... I cannot help but imagine that the sight must have reminded him of a rather tragic event in his past.
那幅光景……过去一定在他身上发生过类似的事情吧。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
An unpleasant event that likely shook mentor Bamboo-hatted Kim to the core.
金笠大人他……一定被那幅光景剧烈动摇了吧。

That alone fits numerous criteria that make it ripe for a manifestation of a Distortion. He was in a very receptive state to the Monolith's influences as well.
那是个发生扭曲的优良条件。他同样也身处极易受独石影响的环境。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
So that is how... the mentor became beholden to his blade. Like a fiend...
然后……他就化身为剑鬼了吗。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Yet... still... how could he...
即便如此……他为何要做这种事……

We remained wordless and advanced as Aeng-du despondently muttered to herself.
在樱桃叹息着喃喃自语之时，我们也不发一语地向前走去……

It was all silent, save for the sound of our shoes lightly pressing into the soft soil beneath our feet.
除了我们踏在泥土之上的声音外，再无其他。
